tools.name: calculate_flip_profit
tools.description: Runs the fixandflip.loans calculator on a deal: profit, cash you put in, return on cash (and simple annualized), profit as % of ARV, the hard-money loan with interest, points and fees, holding and selling costs, the 70% rule maximum price and whether the deal meets it, and the breakeven sale price.

tools.name: compare_lender_costs
tools.description: Prices one flip at each listed lender's advertised fix-and-flip starting rate (from its own website, read 2026-10-24), ranked by profit: interest cost, total financing and profit per lender, with your own leverage, points and fees held the same. tools.name: find_lenders
tools.description: Lists the hard-money and DSCR lenders on fixandflip.loans whose own websites (read 2026-10-24) say they lend in a state, with starting rate, leverage, minimum credit score, experience rule, loan size and a source link each. Lenders that publish no state list are returned as "check".

tools.name: get_lender_terms
tools.description: Everything fixandflip.loans recorded from one lender's own website (read 2026-10-24): fix-and-flip and DSCR rates, leverage, points, terms, credit and experience rules, loan sizes, the states it lends in, license line, notes and the exact source pages.
